briefdescription.para: Terminal pipeline orchestrator — owns Parser, Video, CellFifo, and Model&.

detaileddescription.para: Processor is the Controller in the audio-plugin architecture:

The PTY-side TTY lives in terminal::Processor (created by startTTY()). Processor is data-source agnostic — it receives bytes via process() whether they come from a local PTY callback, an IPC byte-forward, or a history replay.

listitem.para: Caller delivers raw bytes on the READER THREAD via process().
The parser decodes VT sequences and calls Video action methods directly.
Video writes cells to Buffer<Row> and fires events.

Processor reader-thread handlers push departing rows into the history ring via pushHistory() (on pushLine) and live viewport rows into the active ring via pushActive() (on screenDirty), then bump the screenDirty ValueTree counter.
Model::flush() propagates atomic values to the ValueTree on the timer tick, notifying Display via juce::ValueTree::Listener.
Display pulls via drainHistory()/drainActive() on the message thread and feeds its own CodeView.
Resize: prepare() resizes Video's grid only — CellFifo and CodeView untouched. Cell pixel changes are applied to Video directly.
All other public methods — MESSAGE THREAD only.
Model and Buffer<Row> handle their own internal thread safety.
CellFifo is SPSC: reader thread pushes, message thread drains.

simplesect.para: terminal::Session — owns TTY (via Processor::startTTY) and orchestrates startup.
jam::Buffer<jam::Row> — flat row storage, stateless data buffer.
jam::Resizer — coalescing resize coordinator (owned by Session).
Video — terminal state machine: pen, cursor, modes, Buffer<Row> writes.
CellFifo — SPSC ring: reader pushes Char rows, message thread drains jam::CodeLine.
